scoring_justification: The core quantities (Kauzmann temperature and nucleation time) are derivable from the agent’s submitted free-energy/entropy CSV and known theory; τ_eq is deterministic from the provided formula. Therefore the checker recomputes them directly.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for TK, τ_nuc, and τ_eq from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Physical Review E 81, 031501 (2010), Section III and Discussion; Eq. (11) gives TK≃3.18; text gives τ_nuc(3.40)≃4600 MCS and τ_eq(3.40)≃4400 MCS.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper statements.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper‑reported numbers that define the reproduction target; they are publicly available but kept hidden from the agent.

steps.description: Validate file existence and required fields (TK, units) per output contract.
Recompute Kauzmann temperature TK from the configurational entropy in step_02_free_energy.csv and compare to paper gold 3.18.
Validate file existence and required fields (T, tau_nuc, units).
Recompute nucleation time τ_nuc(3.40) from free-energy data, Kauzmann temperature, melting point, and renormalized surface-tension scaling; compare to paper gold 4600 MCS.
Validate file existence and required fields (T, tau_eq, tau_nuc, T_sp).
Check that the agent‑reported τ_eq and τ_nuc are consistent with recomputed values (τ_eq=4460, τ_nuc recomputed) within ±5 % and that T_sp is 3.40.

outputs.description: The computed crystal nucleation time at T=3.40.
Demonstration that tau_eq and tau_nuc are comparable and that T_sp ≈ 3.40.

output_contract.notes: The 2D FPIM analysis is excluded per taskability scope. The equilibration time is computed from the provided relaxation-time formula, not from cooling-rate experiments. The reference nucleation time at T=3.50 is taken as given.
